「すみません」の一言で、世界に責任が発生する

A stranger says, ‘Excuse me.’ Before you know their name, motive, or story, you already face the question of response. レヴィナスのfaceとethics as first philosophyを手がかりに、the other is not exhausted by my descriptions; encounter can place responsibility before complete understanding.
